name: OCR Interceptor
content:
"""
title: OCR & Proofreader Interceptor
author: Open WebUI Community
version: 0.3.0
description: Intercepts images in BOTH legacy and new Multimodal formats, performs OCR, and replaces the image with text.
"""

from typing import Optional, List, Union, Dict
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
import requests
import json
import re


class Filter:
    class Valves(BaseModel):
        vllm_base_url: str = Field(
            default="http://192.168.19.7:8000/v1",
            description="Base URL of the vLLM server (include /v1).",
        )
        model_name: str = Field(
            default="nemotron-ocr-v1",
            description="The model name as recognized by vLLM.",
        )
        ocr_system_prompt: str = Field(
            default="Perform OCR on this image and return only the transcribed text.",
            description="System prompt for the vision-language model.",
        )
        debug_mode: bool = Field(
            default=True,
            description="Print raw message structure to console for debugging.",
        )

    def __init__(self):
        self.valves = self.Valves()

    def log(self, message):
        if self.valves.debug_mode:
            print(f"[OCR Filter] {message}")

    def _clean_base64(self, image_str: str) -> str:
        """Removes data URI header (data:image/xyz;base64,)"""
        if "base64," in image_str:
            return image_str.split("base64,")[1]
        return image_str

    def perform_ocr(self, image_b64: str) -> str:
        # NVIDIA NIM uses the /v1/infer endpoint for this model
        url = f"{self.valves.vllm_base_url}/infer"
        clean_img = self._clean_base64(image_b64)

        # NIM specific payload structure
        payload = {
            "input": [
                {
                    "type": "image_url",
                    "url": f"data:image/png;base64,{clean_img}",
                }
            ]
        }

        try:
            self.log(f"Sending request to NVIDIA NIM ({self.valves.model_name})...")
            response = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=900)
            response.raise_for_status()

            # Parse NIM response structure
            result = response.json()

            # Extract text from the specific Nemotron OCR structure:
            # data -> list -> text_detections -> list -> text_prediction -> text
            extracted_texts = []
            data_list = result.get("data", [])

            if data_list:
                detections = data_list[0].get("text_detections", [])
                for detection in detections:
                    text_val = detection.get("text_prediction", {}).get("text")
                    if text_val:
                        extracted_texts.append(text_val)

            content = "\n".join(extracted_texts)

            # Fallback logic if the specific structure isn't found
            if not content:
                content = result.get("text") or result.get("output") or ""
                if not content and "choices" in result:
                    content = result["choices"][0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")

            self.log(f"OCR Result: {content[:50].replace(chr(10), ' ')}...")
            return content
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(f"Error: {e}")
            if "response" in locals() and response.text:
                self.log(f"Response Body: {response.text}")
            return f"[OCR Error: {e}]"

    def inlet(self, body: dict, __user__: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        messages = body.get("messages", [])
        if not messages:
            return body

        last_msg = messages[-1]
        images_to_process = []

        # --- STEP 1: EXTRACT IMAGES FROM THE LATEST MESSAGE FIRST ---
        # We do this before cleaning so we don't lose the data.

        # Check legacy "images" key
        if "images" in last_msg and last_msg["images"]:
            images_to_process.extend(last_msg["images"])
            # We don't delete yet, we'll clean in Step 2

        # Check multimodal "content" list
        content = last_msg.get("content")
        if isinstance(content, list):
            for item in content:
                if item.get("type") == "image_url":
                    url_data = item.get("image_url", {}).get("url", "")
                    if url_data:
                        images_to_process.append(url_data)

        # --- STEP 2: CLEAN ENTIRE HISTORY (The "Scrub") ---
        # Now that we've saved the images, we strip them from the payload
        # so the LLM API doesn't see them and throw a 422 error.
        for msg in messages:
            # Clean legacy "images" field
            if "images" in msg:
                msg["images"] = []

            # Clean multimodal "content" list
            msg_content = msg.get("content")
            if isinstance(msg_content, list):
                # Create a new list containing only text parts
                new_content_parts = []
                text_accumulator = ""
                for item in msg_content:
                    if item.get("type") == "text":
                        new_content_parts.append(item)
                        text_accumulator += item.get("text", "") + "\n"
                    # image_url items are implicitly dropped here

                # If it was a list, we convert it to a plain string
                # to make it safe for the LLM.
                msg["content"] = text_accumulator.strip()

        # --- STEP 3: PROCESS THE EXTRACTED IMAGES ---
        if images_to_process:
            self.log(f"Processing {len(images_to_process)} images...")
            ocr_results = []

            for i, img in enumerate(images_to_process):
                text = self.perform_ocr(img)
                ocr_results.append(
                    f"\n--- Image {i+1} Transcript ---\n{text}\n------------------------------\n"
                )

            # Get the text from the last message (which is now a string thanks to Step 2)
            current_text = last_msg.get("content", "")
            if not isinstance(current_text, str):
                current_text = ""

            # Append OCR text to the user prompt
            last_msg["content"] = current_text + "\n".join(ocr_results)

            body["messages"][-1] = last_msg
            self.log("Body updated successfully with OCR text.")
        else:
            self.log("No images found in the latest message.")

        return body

    def outlet(self, body: dict, __user__: Optional[dict] = None) -> dict:
        return body
